# Support

- **Bugs and ideas for the Australian layer:** open an [issue](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-fpa-pack/issues), or use the [contact page](https://duguid.com.au/contact/) if you would rather not post publicly. Give the version or commit, the command you ran, the result you expected and the result you received, with the smallest reproduction you can make from fabricated data.
- **Bugs or ideas for the shared openfpa kernel:** use [openfpa's issues](https://github.com/JeffBrines/openfpa/issues).
- **Security vulnerabilities:** follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) and never report one publicly.

Never send client, taxpayer, employee, payroll, banking or credential data. There is no service level agreement or guaranteed response time.
